pose_constraints.posture: Strictly vertical 'Pillar' orientation. Standing on powerful hind legs with the chest puffed forward.
pose_constraints.orientation: 0-degree head-on frontal view. The head is tilted slightly down (10 degrees) to show the top of the broad skull.
pose_constraints.camera_angle: Low-angle 'Hero' shot to emphasize the bulk and power of the chest and neck.
pose_constraints.body_logic: Width is kept under 320px by keeping the arms tucked tight to the ribs and the tail hidden directly behind the torso. The deep skull is the focal point.
pose_constraints.framing_note: The snout is centered and pointing toward the camera, ensuring the length doesn't break the horizontal bounds.

character_details.expression: Grumpy and imposing; a heavy brow ridge over large, glowing orange eyes. A 'tough guy' personality.
character_details.texture: Clean, matte-finish skin with a heavy, 'armored' feel on the shoulders. Soft, painterly shadows define the muscle without adding grit.
character_details.colors: Charcoal-grey body with a bold, burnt-sienna 'war paint' pattern over the eyes and down the snout. Light tan underbelly.
features: Deep, robust megalosaurid skull with a heavy, squared-off snout.
Short, muscular arms with large, simplified claws tucked close.

environmental_details.ground: Dry, cracked earth with a few low-lying, bright green Jurassic ferns.
flora: Oversized, simplified cycad trees in the distant background to add verticality.
environmental_details.lighting: Harsh, high-contrast afternoon sun. Strong rim-lighting on the top of the head and shoulders to separate the dark body from the sky.
